title: U.S. Coast Guard rescues 3 fishermen after vessel sinks off Honolulu
description: Crew from 25-foot fishing vessel Ichiban wait for a MH-65 Dolphin helicopter to arrive as flooding progresses off Honolulu, Hawaii, Sept. 19. Coast Guard Sector Honolulu received notification from Honolulu Fire Department that 25-foot fishing vessel, Ichiban, was taking on water nine miles offshore of Honolulu Harbor.
